name: Adobe Lightroom
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Adobe Lightroom, catalog local photos and apply basic non-destructive adjustments. The hard boundary is adobe raw engine, cloud sync, mobile apps, ai masks, ecosystem, and long-term camera support, plus image pipeline quality, models, and workflow polish.
